title: Q-SYS-DEPLOY-ALL: SYS-7: deploy every declared worker and store from the topology
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:deploy/deploy-system.mjs::topology.json
**Status:** open

`python3 -m foundation topology --drift` lists bindings declared in doctrine/topology.json but not deployed: the tick worker's AI, SITE, DASHBOARD and AGENTS bindings, the dashboard's TICK binding. deploy/deploy-system.mjs builds bindings from doctrine/system.json for AI and D1 only and defaults to the agents worker. Make it read doctrine/topology.json (as deploy/deploy-site.mjs does), build every binding type for any worker in DEPLOY_WORKERS (d1, kv, ai, services, queues, vectorize, vars), create planned stores before the workers that bind them, deploy tick, dashboard and agents, and probe each /health.
Paths: deploy/deploy-system.mjs, .github/workflows/deploy-system.yml, doctrine/topology.json.
Acceptance: after the run, `topology --drift` reports no declared-but-undeployed bindings.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:deploy/deploy-system.mjs::topology.json; drift on /live shows none.
